findings_aggregated_for_sde.desc: [AI-SAST via Code Scan Verification Validation | claude-opus-5] No broken or mis-parameterised algorithm is in use on either reviewed path, and no encoding routine stands in for encryption. app/apis/auth/utils/utils.py pins argon2id at time_cost=3, memory_cost=65536 (64 MiB) and parallelism=4 per OWASP guidance, with bcrypt rounds=12 as the floor for legacy hashes being retired and verify_and_update migrating them on the next successful login; passlib generates the per-hash salt. app/jwt_tokens.py pins HS256 as a module literal, never reading the algorithm from the token header, so 'none' or a key-confusion swap is not expressible; jti uses secrets.token_urlsafe. Keys are separated by purpose and length-floored elsewhere in config (JWT_SECRET_KEY and OTP_HMAC_KEY are distinct and each at least 32 characters / 256 bits). Alternative mitigation accepted: explicit in-code parameter pinning delivers the approved-algorithm and key-length property the CM requires | verdict=pass confidence=high
